_comment: AGENTS.md rule 13: the hook entries .claude/settings.json needs (merged next to the existing ones).
Owner applies them: python .claude/hooks/harness_status.py --write-proposed <file>, check, copy over .claude/settings.json.
Commands run in Git Bash. A missing script exits 0 (fail open, e.g. a fresh clone where .claude/hooks is not checked out).
The inbox command reads runs.json with bash builtins only: while nothing is bound Python never starts (cost = the bash start).
launch_gate always exits 0 (it denies through JSON); inbox_hook's exit 2 on SubagentStop is deliberate and passes through exec.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/inbox_hook.py"; r="${AOP_TASKS_DIR:-$HOME/Documents/WORKSPACE/korean-buildings-blender/research/Texturing_11/Claude_CP2/tasks}/inbox/runs.json"; b=; [ -f "$f" ] && [ -f "$r" ] && IFS= read -r -d '' b < "$r"; case "$b" in *'"'*) exec python "$f";; esac; exit 0
